requirement: This code should implement a concrete builder class named `ConcreteBuilder` which adheres to an interface `ITF_Builder`. It should manage the construction of a `Product` object based on specifications provided by a director class. The class should have methods to initialize with given specifications (`specs`), set parts of the product (`mainPart`, `part1`, `part2`, `part3`), and retrieve parts or the complete product. The specifications are stored in an array of strings, and each part of the product is set and retrieved through individual methods. The builder initializes with a boolean indicating if retain variables are initialized (`bInitRetains`) and if the instance will be copied to copy-code (`bInCopyCode`). The methods for setting parts should handle the assignment of string values to respective parts of the `Product`, and the retrieval methods should return these values or the complete product object.
provide_code:

VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT

requirement_cn: 此代码应实现一个名为 `ConcreteBuilder` 的具体建造者类，该类实现 `ITF_Builder` 接口。它应负责根据导演类提供的规格管理 `Product` 对象的构建。类应具有用给定规格（`specs`）初始化、设置产品的部分（`mainPart`、`part1`、`part2`、`part3`）以及检索部分或完整产品的方法。规格存储在字符串数组中，每个产品部分通过单独的方法设置和检索。构建器初始化时有一个布尔值指示是否初始化保留变量（`bInitRetains`）以及实例是否将被复制到复制代码（`bInCopyCode`）。设置部分的方法应处理将字符串值分配给 `Product` 的相应部分，检索方法应返回这些值或完整的产品对象。
